reviews.title: The Free Version Is Completely Useless
reviews.text: Why offer a free version if it’s practically impossible to use? You get to practice for five seconds, and then an ad pops up. You can’t continue practicing until you click the link in the ad. Essentially, the free version is completely useless. That’s why I see no point in paying for the full version — the free version hasn’t given me any value in the first place.

reviews.title: Would be good
reviews.text: I completely understand that apps have to make money somehow, usually through ads. This app, however, takes it to a new level with how often you want to watch an add if you aren’t able to pay the subscription fee. You should be able to play it in a game form rather than learning properly for free, and then any part of repetition or learning and skills should be payed for. You literally press a few keys and are forced to sit through ads longer than you were using the app itself for. Completely infuriating.
